name: Pixie
description: Pixies are fey creatures shaped like tiny humanoids, but with magical fairy wings. When in flight, they appear as orbs of colorful light and are often mistaken for large glowbugs. These mischievous creatures are most notable for their love of playing sometimes deadly pranks on unsuspecting humanoids.

actions.name: Poof
actions.description: In response to being targeted by an attack, the pixie gains a 2d4 bonus to their defense check. If they successfully avoid the attack, they teleport to an unoccupied space within 4 units.

actions.name: Prick
actions.description: The pixie makes an attack with a very small needle-like weapon, dealing physical damage. On a true hit, this attack deals psychic damage instead.

actions.name: Innate Invisibility
actions.description: After channeling a spell, the pixie uses the residual magic left over to become invisible until the end of it's next turn, unless broken naturally.

traits.name: Feywild Magic
traits.description: While in the feywild, the pixie does not require power to channel their spells.

traits.name: Fairy Flight
traits.description: The pixie has magical flight and does not need use the Move action to maintain their current height.

traits.name: Blackened Iron Aversion
traits.description: The pixie has an aversion to blackened iron, gaining a 1d4 penalty to all attacks when within 2 units of a creature that has a piece of equipment that has that property.
